title: Unitary highest weight modules for $\mathfrak{su}(p, q)$ and $\mathfrak{so}^{*}(2n)$ with fixed integral infinitesimal character
summary: We classify unitary highest weight modules with a given integral infinitesimal character for the real Lie algebras $\mathfrak{su}(p,q)$ and $\mathfrak{so}^*(2n)$. We treat both regular and singular cases. For $\mathfrak{su}(p,q)$ we identify the unitarizable modules in the Hasse diagrams of the highest weight orbit. Analogous results for the other Hermitian Lie algebras were given in our earlier publications.
